Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) Software Engineering & Development, Officer 
 Make Tomorrow Happen. Advance your career at State Street.  
 We are excited to see that you are reviewing career opportunities available at State Street. Follow the tips below when applying. If this opportunity is not right for you – perhaps you may want to refer a friend?
 
 Are you advancing your own career?  
 After clicking “Apply” you will be able to update your Education and Job History. Use it to highlight courses, certifications, achievements or projects you have participated in at State Street. To make updates, go to the Career section of your Profile and edit it manually or by using the “Upload My Experience” option. Remember to review all new entries in your profile and make sure resume information was parsed correctly.
 Before applying, please visit  Career Central - Home  to read State Street’s Internal Mobility Policy.
 
 Are you referring a friend?  
 
 Please use the “Refer” button on the right. If you have any questions about the process please visit the corporate intranet and type in  Refer a Friend  into the search bar.
 
 Job Description 
 Who we are looking for 
 We are looking for an ETF Software Developer reporting directly to the ETF Platform Owner. You will contribute to the development, enhancement, and maintenance of data quality and data delivery applications as part of an agile scrum team, working with a strong global development group to build challenging, cutting‑edge products in the financial domain.
 
 Why this role is important to us 
 The team you will be joining is part of the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) Servicing  function, a capability that is vital to the company as it enables the timely, reliable, and scalable delivery of critical financial data that supports core ETF operations, reporting, and decision‑making.
 
 What you will be responsible for 
 As Software Developer you will
 Develop, validate and install minor enhancements based on delivery trends from daily ETF Servicing cycles
 Work independently to develop, test, and debug ETF software enhancements and solutions within the business and technical problem domains
 Develop, test, debug, and implement software programs, applications and projects using cloud computing tools and other related software engineering languages
 Write unit and automation tests to ensure a high-quality end product
 Participate in code reviews
 Actively participate in the agile software development process by adhering to the scrum methodology including attending all daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
 Triage production issues by reviewing code and logs as needed and come up with solutions
 
 What we value  
 These skills will help you succeed in this role
 Extensive Java n-tier application experience
 Good understanding of AI enabled programming
 Cloud technologies, methodologies and implementation tools
 Extensive data and database tooling experience
 
 Education & Preferred Qualifications 
 Commercial software development, proficient in developing multi-tier solutions
 BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent field
 Knowledgeable of commercial software development,
 Professional PL/SQL and Java development experience
 Excellent communication skills (verbal and written), good interpersonal skills
 Ability to gather and understand requirements in the financial sector 
 Able to work well with peers in a collaborative team environment
 Experience working with an Agile development methodology is desired
 
 Additional requirements 
 Ability to analyze ETF business requirements and develop solutions to the business needs
 Strong communication skills, self-motivated, detail oriented, and highly responsible.
 Strong collaboration skills, working with multiple teams in various locations in an agile environment.
 
 
 Additional Locations
